scoring_justification: Recomputing the band gap from raw DOS data is not feasible because DOS/spectral files are not guaranteed output artifacts; we compare the reported band gap to the paper’s reference value with tolerance appropriate for toolchain spread. Orbital characters are checked exactly.

hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper reports a DFT+DMFT gap of ~3.0 eV (Fig. 4(a), text).
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted from paper conclusion and main text.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: This is the published scientific result; the checker compares the agent’s computed gap to this value.

hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper identifies HVB as LHB(d_z2) spin‑up and LCB as LHB(d_x2-y2) spin‑up; paramagnetic gap exists (Fig. 4, text).
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted from the paper’s description of the Hubbard bands.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These labels and the insulating nature of the paramagnetic phase are the paper’s explicit findings; checking them verifies reproduction of the orbital assignment claim.

schema.description: A single floating-point number representing the DFT+DMFT band gap.

outputs.description: Mott insulating gap from the ferromagnetic DFT+DMFT calculation.
Orbital character of the lower Hubbard bands and insulating nature of the paramagnetic phase.

output_contract.notes: The band gap is compared against the DFT+DMFT reference value with an appropriate tolerance. Orbital labels must match the expected character (e.g., 'Cr d_{z^2} spin-up') and paramagnetic_gap_consistent must be true.

steps.description: Mott insulating gap from FM DFT+DMFT. Compare to paper gold ~3.0 eV with tolerance ±0.5 eV.
Orbital character of Hubbard bands and PM insulating nature. Exact match required.
